To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the design of fuzzy-logic controllers (FLCs), based on heuristic fuzzy-rules, can be made to be stable if each rule in the controller is stable in the ISL sense and the Lyapunov functions of these subsystems can be found.
the stability of the whole nonlinear system with a fuzzy logic controller (FLC) is guaranteed if each subsystem is ISL under a common Lyaponuv function.
we have developed an approach to designing fuzzy logic controllers (for nonlinear systems) that guarantees closed-loop stability, and that we have applied this approach to combining controllers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and application of fuzzy logic controllers with guaranteed stability.

the design of fuzzy controllers for nonlinear systems with the following features: (i) the design does not need a fuzzy plant model; (ii) the stability of the closed-loop systems can be guaranteed; (iii) the design can be used to combine different controllers.
the stability analysis and synthesis of nonlinear systems with fuzzy control, especially with combining controllers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the design of FLCs based on the ISL approach is a powerful tool for designing combining controllers for complex nonlinear systems.
the proposed design approach can be used for the design of FLCs with guaranteed stability and its application to the combination of controllers.
the proposed FLC design approach provides a systematic method for designing stable combining controllers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a new method is proposed to design an FLC for nonlinear systems with stability guarantees.
a Lyapunov-function approach has been proposed for the stability analysis and design of FLCs, and its application to combining controllers.
the FLC is not only a controller but also a scheduler.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, by using the Lyapunov-function based approach, a fuzzy logic controller can be designed to combine different control schemes, and guarantee the overall system stability.
a FLC with guaranteed stability can be designed by the proposed design method.
, by combining the two different controllers, the FLC can be designed in a systematic manner, and the stability of the overall system can be guaranteed.
